description: This PHP class 'ArrayModel' implements a simple wrapper around an array, providing a method to serialize it back to an array. It is part of the OrangeHRM project's API V2 models, specifically for data serialization.

classes.name: ArrayModel
classes.description: A model class that encapsulates an array with a method to serialize it.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ArrayModel with the provided data array.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the encapsulated data as an array.
